err.site_on_q:
Add to .user.ini in the root:

log_errors = On
error_log = "<root>/php_error.log"

It works with PHP-FPM/CGI (e.g. Plesk) and becomes active within {ttl} seconds. You can undo it from the same menu.

set.reset_hint: Erases settings, database and window layout: Scaffolder Pro restarts as if just installed. Project files and the password stay.
js.reset_q:
Reset Scaffolder Pro as if just installed?

These are deleted: settings (language, Anthropic API key, editor), file versions, trash, activity log, API requests, working root and recent roots, column widths and card layout, open tabs.

They stay: the files of your projects and the password in .htpasswd.

This cannot be undone.
